headline: Tanker Reported Disabled Near Khasab
deck: A UKMTO warning based on a third-party report places an engine-room fire north of Oman; cargo, repairs and transit measures have not been reported.
body: United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations said, citing a third-party report, that a tanker transiting the Strait of Hormuz was disabled after a reported attack caused an engine-room fire. [E4][E7] gCaptain reported two tanker attacks, both with engine-room fires, with one vessel disabled. [E1]
The latest incident was reported at about 1900 UTC, seven nautical miles north of Khasab, Oman. [E2][E5][E9]

UKMTO did not identify the tanker or an attacker, and the reports gave no immediate details of the vessel or the cause of the attack. [E3][E6][E8] Cargo, repair arrangements and measures for other transits have not been reported.
The crew was reported safe, while the extent of damage and any environmental effect were not known. [E10]

The paper reported an Iranian claim on 16 November that a supertanker carrying more than two million barrels of crude sank after an explosion and fire. [E11] This UKMTO warning instead describes an unidentified disabled tanker.
